intent: Make a simple invoice generator page: enter line items, compute VAT at 12%, export to print.

spec.goal: Create a simple invoice generator web page where the user enters line items, has VAT calculated at 12%, and can print the invoice.
spec.deliverable: A simple invoice generator web page with line item entry, automatic 12% VAT calculation, and a print-ready export.
constraints: The page must stay simple in scope and design.
VAT must be calculated at a rate of 12%.
The user must be able to enter line items on the page.
Export is for print, so the invoice must print cleanly.
done_criteria: The user can enter one or more line items on the page.
The page computes the subtotal, the VAT at 12%, and the total from the entered line items.
The user can print the invoice and the printed output shows the line items and totals clearly.
spec.summary: You want a simple invoice generator page where you enter line items, see VAT calculated at 12%, and print the invoice.
